newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Port conditions update - Pakistan - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Pakistan - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service-

KARACHI, Oct 14 - Vessels waiting off port - five general cargo, the first waiting five days. One container waiting for two days. One sugar waiting for four days. Two fertilisers, the first waiting 13 days. One rock/phosphate waiting for seven days. One oil tanker waiting for two days. Ten other vessels laid up off port for their own reasons.
